<!--
Status         draft → ship (date), written only after Luka watched the render and said `ship`.
Creator        who is on screen. Source: the public URL. From/To: timecodes in that video.
Start          seconds into assets/source.mp4 where the clip begins (bin/clip-fetch sets it to the pad).
Target seconds length of the clip, 7–60. Start ~0.5 s before the peak.
Layout         crop  = 9:16 crop of the gameplay, "Crop x" 0–100 moves the window left→right
               stack = facecam on top + gameplay below; "Cam: x,y,w,h" is the facecam box in source pixels
               fit   = whole 16:9 frame in the middle, hook above, captions below
Hook           the line on screen from frame 0, in the series language, with the phrase people search
               ("GTA 6 …"). At most ~7 words. "Hook accent": the word(s) of the hook to colour.
Credit         shown on screen all clip long, e.g. "@creator · Twitch". Never empty.
Zooms          seconds (clip time) for a punch-in, comma separated. Optional.
Posted         URL of the TikTok once uploaded by hand.
-->
